fact: IDLO's RFP of 31 August 2023 says federal courts use only a basic web-based case management system, in use only in the Benadir Regional Court, Benadir Appeal Court and the Supreme Court, and seeks a vendor to build an integrated e-case management system with e-filing and lawyer access.
title: Request For Proposal RFP N_211_2023_SOM: Development and Delivery of Integrated Electronic Case Management System for Somalia's Justice Chain Institutions
